depictions.name: Mount Tatsu
depictions.text: Mount Tatsu was a mountain besides Tatsuyama Quarry in Harima, Japan. In 1582, the Kakushiba ikki members Fujibayashi Naoe and Yasuke climbed atop the mountain and surveyed the quarry and the land below them.
